author: FrostedCupcakez
body:
Hey Everyone! ^-^

For the past few days, I've been writing a story called Mercy after being inspired by Seth and Bader from their fanfics. 
I'll be updating this every four chapters, which usually takes a day or two to write. I hope you enjoy my story and if you would like to be featured in it or have any suggestions, reply down below or feel free to message me on Skype!
 
  • Chapters 1-4: http://pastebin.com/cEfEAVXk
  • Chapters 5-8: http://pastebin.com/QbSYJX27
  • Chapters 9-12: http://pastebin.com/SGdme9dc
